title: Idhaya Veenai
desc: Sundaram, after leaving home, becomes entangled with a deceitful man, Annamalai. Falsely accused of a crime, he faces numerous challenges that test his integrity and resilience.

title: Seevalaperi Pandi
desc: Five villagers, unhappy with the judgments of the chief of their village, join forces with his bodyguard Pandi to kill him. But Pandi gets capital punishment while the others are acquitted.

title: Veluchami
desc: A man raises Veluchami, an orphan, alongside his daughter. However, when he tries to give his daughter to a temple, Veluchami ends up marrying her to keep her safe.

title: Poi
desc: Valluvanar is an honest politician. When his son Kamban is arrested, he refuses to bail him out of jail. The opposition party takes advantage of the situation and thus helps Kamban escape from jail.

title: Otran
desc: A group of terrorists kidnaps Sudha and takes over her apartment to save their employer Robert. Karthik, a RAW agent, pretends to be a cook and goes to her house to capture the entire gang.
